limitations: Shares are medians taken independently per role, so the two stacked bars need not sum to exactly 1.0; read each segment on its own, not the total bar length. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Median share of total script time per role (features_json.script.<role>_share), stacked, compared between the top and bottom robust_z quartile inside the analysis-ready-adjacent corpus.
title: Script part shares, strong vs weak

variables.split: top vs bottom quartile of robust_z
